nodes.label: Animation Glossary
nodes.rationale: Curated reverse-lookup glossary mapping vague motion descriptions to precise technical terms, enabling users to communicate animation intent accurately to designers and AI systems.

nodes.label: Three Design Dials (Variance/Motion/Density)
nodes.rationale: DESIGN_VARIANCE/MOTION_INTENSITY/VISUAL_DENSITY dials encode the core design read into three orthogonal axes, allowing every layout/motion/density decision to be derived from a single consistent configuration rather than made ad hoc.

nodes.label: AI Tells (Forbidden Patterns)
nodes.rationale: Explicit catalog of LLM-default design clichés that signal AI-generated output; banning them forces the model past its training distribution toward more distinctive, brief-appropriate design.

nodes.label: Motion Library Choice (Motion vs GSAP vs Three.js)

nodes.label: Animation Decision Framework
nodes.rationale: Four sequential questions (Should it animate? Purpose? Easing? Speed?) derived from Emil Kowalski's philosophy prevent purposeless motion and force every animation to earn its place.
